description: Reviewed weather and environmental products: source rights, native model files and inventories, forecasts, alerts, aurora and fire snapshots. Preserve native units and source timestamps. Operations: catalog, sources, source, variables, status, models, model, runs, run, inventory, assets, asset_metadata, forecast, alerts. Large native responses use bounded summaries with the REST path. Download binary files separately through authenticated Range requests. No decoded field values are inferred.

area.description: One to five comma-separated NWS area codes, e.g. IN. Choose area or point. (alerts)

cursor.description: Signed continuation token for this same source, prefix and page size. (run)

date.description: UTC source date as YYYYMMDD; defaults to the current date. A listed directory is discovered, not proof of a complete forecast run. (runs)

hourly.description: Return the native hourly forecast when true; preserve provider units. (forecast)

lat.description: WGS84 latitude, rounded to four decimal places for NWS point lookup. (forecast)

modelId.description: Concrete dataset or source identifier returned by the catalog. (model)

objectKey.description: Exact relative native object key from this dataset's live listing. URLs and path traversal are refused. (inventory)
